definition.en: The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) are a universal call to action adopted by the United Nations in 2015 to end poverty, protect the planet, and ensure that by 2030 all people enjoy peace and prosperity.
definition.hi: The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) are a universal call to action adopted by the United Nations in 2015 to end poverty, protect the planet, and ensure that by 2030 all people enjoy peace and prosperity.

importanceInUpsc.en: SDGs are highly relevant for UPSC GS-3 as they provide the framework for India's developmental policies and economic planning. Understanding these goals is essential for answering questions on poverty, inequality, climate action, and inclusive growth in both Prelims and Mains.
importanceInUpsc.hi: SDGs are highly relevant for UPSC GS-3 as they provide the framework for India's developmental policies and economic planning. Understanding these goals is essential for answering questions on poverty, inequality, climate action, and inclusive growth in both Prelims and Mains.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the 17 global goals and their relevance to the Indian economic context.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the 17 global goals and their relevance to the Indian economic context.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the role of NITI Aayog in monitoring and implementing SDGs at the national and sub-national levels.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the role of NITI Aayog in monitoring and implementing SDGs at the national and sub-national levels.
